observation_summary: The method getCovariances() in AbstractEstimator throws an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException when bound parameters are present because it iterates over all parameters instead of only the unbound ones.
reasoning_summary: The defect is an algorithmic error in the loop logic. The code incorrectly uses the total number of parameters (all parameters) to define the iteration bounds for a Jacobian matrix that only contains data for the unbound parameters. This mismatch between the data structure size and the iteration logic causes the out-of-bounds access. This is a procedural/computational logic error rather than a missing guard (Checking) or a simple initialization error.
evidence_used: AbstractEstimator.java:173: sum += jacobian[k + i] * jacobian[k + j];
Bug report description: The reason is that the Jacobian is calculated only for the unbound parameters. in the code you loop through all parameters.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While adding a check could prevent the crash, the root cause is the incorrect use of the total parameter count in an algorithm designed to process only unbound parameters.
This is a local procedural error within an existing method, not a missing design capability or a structural deficiency.
